name: 竹浆本色亲肤柔韧抽纸款
description: 竹浆本色不漂白、湿水不易破、绵柔亲肤母婴可用

styleLock.direction: soft pastel home-daily paper goods ecommerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating clean white #FFFFFF, misty light blue #D9E8F3 and soft sakura pink #F5A9A3 color-block backgrounds with rounded info cards
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio lighting, gentle directional shadows and soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light board #ECECEA, warm white tabletop #F7F5F2, plain pedestal cubes
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in #33383D on light backgrounds and #FFFFFF on colored backgrounds, 28-48pt headline scale with 16-20pt subtitles and 10-14pt labels
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line circular outline icons, single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable soft-pack tissue pack silhouette and scale across the set, pack upright or flat as stated per shot
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft pastel home-daily e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, misty light blue #D9E8F3, soft sakura pink #F5A9A3, text in #33383D and one teal accent #5FBFAE; bright soft diffused studio lighting with gentle directional shadows and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in #33383D; consistent rounded rectangular info cards and thin-line circular outline icons; clean high-end home-daily product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable soft-pack product silhouette and scale, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, soft pack standing upright, full pack visible, not clipped
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level view of the soft pack standing upright, full product visible and not clipped by the frame, the pack filling 60-70% of the frame as a clean square composition. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, one soft contact shadow grounding the pack. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF with even margins all around so the frame reads as one complete balanced layout. 8K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no colored background tint, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒说清本色亲肤的核心利益，承接首屏点击
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle, pack on the right third
shots.lighting: soft front-left key light, soft contact shadow
shots.textZone: left side carries one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #33383D with a thin underline in #5FBFAE, plus one small rounded spec badge 「{callout_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The pack photographed at a slight 3/4 angle on the right third, occupying 50-60% of the frame. The left side carries one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #33383D with a thin underline in #5FBFAE, one thin-line circular outline icon in #5FBFAE and one small rounded spec badge 「{callout_1}」, so the left text column and the right product column read as one finished composition. Background misty light blue #D9E8F3, soft front-left key light, soft contact shadow. Negative: no dense body text, no more than one claim, no invented specs or numbers, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product.

shots.intent: 放大普通漂白纸掉屑、湿后易破的日常痛点
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, identical straight-on camera on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel harsh flat light; right panel soft gentle light
shots.textZone: one short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #33383D
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical straight-on camera and framing, each sheet occupying 50-60% of its panel. Left panel: an ordinary #FFFFFF tissue sheet under harsh flat light, looking thin and shedding visible lint. Right panel: {product} with a soft, sturdy sheet in clean gentle light. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Background clean white #FFFFFF on both panels. Each panel carries one short label 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #33383D placed at the top of its panel so the two-panel comparison reads as one complete layout. Negative: no fabricated test results or statistics, no real brand packaging, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入日常居家随手取用的真实生活场景
shots.lighting: soft natural window light from the left, 5500K, soft contact shadow
shots.background: airy wall #F7F5F2 with a sheer curtain hint
shots.props: an open magazine and a small #FFFFFF vase with dried stems, not covering the product
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} resting on a warm #F7F5F2 tabletop beside an open magazine and a small #FFFFFF vase with dried stems, the pack filling 40-50% of the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a slight 3/4 eye-level angle with a candid handheld feel, composed so the tabletop still life fills the frame with natural breathing margins and no dead empty zones. Soft natural window light from the left, 5500K, soft contact shadow. Background airy wall #F7F5F2 with a sheer curtain hint. Props: an open magazine and a small #FFFFFF vase, not covering the product. Negative: no people, no hands, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cluttered scene, no duplicated background objects.

shots.intent: 用层间截面与纤维纹理证明用料与工艺
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, top-down 90-degree overhead angle on the fanned sheet edge, shallow depth of field, foreground sharp
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing fiber texture and ply separation
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the fanned edge of stacked tissue sheets showing the distinct plies of the cross-section. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a top-down 90-degree overhead macro angle, shallow depth of field with the foreground edge sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing fiber texture and clean ply separation. Background matte light-grey board #ECECEA. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with only minimal margins around it, because the detail is the whole point. One small annotation label 「{callout_1}」 in #33383D near the fanned edge. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented layer counts or numbers, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props.

provenance.notes: 从 9 张竹浆抽纸爆款详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源英文标语、页面 logo、会员二维码水印与原文案，所有规格与卖点改用 {callout}、{selling_point} 槽位由使用方填写；panel-08/09 为空白展示位无信息量，仅计入分析；产品一律以 {product} 占位。
